transcript.en: Hi. Can I help you?
transcript.zh: 您好，有什么我可以帮您的吗？

transcript.en: I'd like to find out if you have any excursions suitable for families.
transcript.zh: 我想知道你们有适合全家参与的短途旅行吗？

transcript.en: Sure How about taking your family for a cruise?
transcript.zh: 当然有了。要不要试试带您的家人一起来一次巡航旅游？

transcript.en: We have a steamship that takes passengers out several times a day- it's over 100 years old.
transcript.zh: 我们这里有艘拥有百年历史的蒸汽船，一天内可以多次载客出游哦。

transcript.en: That sounds interesting.How long is the trip?
transcript.zh: 听起来不错。这个行程有多长呢？

transcript.en: About an hour and a half.
transcript.zh: 将近一个半小时。

transcript.en: And don't forget to take pictures of the mountains.
transcript.zh: 到时别忘了拍些高山的照片哦。

transcript.en: They're all around you when you're on the boat and they look fantastic.
transcript.zh: 当你在船上时它们可以随处可见，那画面看起来非常棒。

transcript.en: OK. And I assume there's a cafe or something on board?
transcript.zh: 好的。你们船上应该有些咖啡厅之类的吧？

transcript.en: Sure.How old are your children?
transcript.zh: 当然，您的孩子多大了呢？

transcript.en: Er. my daughter's fifteen and my son's seven.
transcript.zh: 女儿15岁，儿子7岁。

transcript.en: Right. Well there are various things you can do once you've crossed the lake,to make a day of it.
transcript.zh: 好的，在你们穿过湖之后，那里会有很多你们可以做，足够花费一整天的时间。

transcript.en: One thing that's very popular is a visit to the Country Farm.
transcript.zh: 参观实际农场是我们这非常热门的一项活动。

transcript.en: You're met off the boat by the farmer and he'll take you to the holding pens,
transcript.zh: 有农民工将你们接下船，他会把你们带牲畜那边。

transcript.en: where the sheep are kept. Children love feeding them!
transcript.zh: 在那里他们养了羊。孩子们都很喜欢给它们喂食。

transcript.en: My son would love that.
transcript.zh: 我儿子应该会喜欢。

transcript.en: He really likes animals.
transcript.zh: 他很喜欢小动物。

transcript.en: Well, there's also a 40-minute trek round the farm on a horse, if he wants.
transcript.zh: 那里还有长达四十分钟的骑马环游农场的活动，如果他有兴趣的话。

transcript.en: Do you think he'd manage it?
transcript.zh: 你觉得他做得了吗?

transcript.en: He hasn't done that before.
transcript.zh: 他从来没骑过马。

transcript.en: Sure.It's suitable for complete beginners.
transcript.zh: 当然，这个活动完全适合新手。

transcript.en: Ah.good.
transcript.zh: 那就好。

transcript.en: And again, visitors are welcome to explore the farm on their own,
transcript.zh: 还有，我们非常欢迎游客们自己来探索这座农场，

transcript.en: as long as they take care to close gates and so on.
transcript.zh: 只要他们注意关好大门等等。

transcript.en: There are some very beautiful gardens along the side of the lake which also belong to the farm- they'II be just at their best now.
transcript.zh: 沿着湖边还有一些很美丽的花园，它们也是农场的一部分。这个时候去刚好是最合适的时间。

transcript.en: You could easily spend an hour or two there.
transcript.zh: 在那里你可以轻松打发一到两个小时的时间。

transcript.en: OK. Well that all sounds good.
transcript.zh: 这些听起来蛮不错的。

transcript.en: And can we get lunch there?
transcript.zh: 在那边有午餐吃吗？

transcript.en: You can, and it's very good, though it's not included in the basic cost.
transcript.zh: 有的，而且很棒。但是午餐不包括在基本消费中，

transcript.en: you pay when you get there.
transcript.zh: 你需要到了那边之后再付费享用。

transcript.en: Right.
transcript.zh: 好的。

transcript.en: So is there anything else to do over on that side of the lake?
transcript.zh: 在湖的另一边有什么其他的活动吗？

transcript.en: Well, what you can do is take a bike over on the ship and then go on a cycling trip.
transcript.zh: 你可以带上自行车上船，然后去享受单车旅行。

transcript.en: There's a trail there called the Back Road- you could easily spend three or four hours exploring it.
transcript.zh: 在那边有一条叫Back Road的车道，你可以花上三四个小时去逛它。

transcript.en: and the scenery's wonderful.
transcript.zh: 沿途的景色非常棒

transcript.en: They'll give you a map when you get your ticket for the cruise- there's no extra charge.
transcript.zh: 在拿到巡航旅行的票时他们会免费给你一份地图。

transcript.en: What's the trail like in terms of difficulty?
transcript.zh: 那条路是不是很难骑呢？

transcript.en: Quite challenging in places.
transcript.zh: 非常具有挑战性哦。

transcript.en: It wouldn't be suitable for your seven-year-old.
transcript.zh: 对于您七岁的儿子来说应该是不合适的。

transcript.en: It needs someone who's got a bit more experience.
transcript.zh: 这个项目适合有一些经验的人。

transcript.en: Hmm. Well, my daughter loves cycling and so do I, so maybe the two of us could go,
transcript.zh: 好吧，我女儿和我一样很喜欢骑车，所以我们可以一起，

transcript.en: and my wife and son could stay on the farm.
transcript.zh: 那我的儿子和妻子可以待在农场里面。

transcript.en: That might work out quite well.
transcript.zh: 这样分配貌似不错。

transcript.en: But we don't have bikes here…is there somewhere we could rent them ?
transcript.zh: 但是我们没有自行车了……那里有租车的地方吗？

transcript.en: Yes, there's a place here in the city. It's called Ratchesons.
transcript.zh: 有的呢，在市区就有。这个地方叫Ratchesons。

transcript.en: I'll just make a note of that- er, how do you spell it?
transcript.zh: 我记一下吧，这个地方怎么拼？

transcript.en: R-A-T-C-H-E-S-0-N-S.
transcript.zh: R-A-T-C-H-E-S-O-N-S。

transcript.en: It's Just by the cruise ship terminal.
transcript.zh: 它就在游船的终点站。

transcript.en: OK.
transcript.zh: 好的。

transcript.en: You'd also need to pick up a repair kit for the bike from there to take along with you,
transcript.zh: 除了车，你还需要带上一个工具包，

transcript.en: and you'd need to take along a snack and some water -it'd be best to get those in the city.
transcript.zh: 同时带点零食和水。这些东西最好在市区就买好。

transcript.en: Fine. That shouldn't be a problem.
transcript.zh: 没问题。

transcript.en: And I assume I can rent a helmet from the bike place?
transcript.zh: 我应该能在租车的地方租个头盔吧？

transcript.en: Sure. you should definitely get that.
transcript.zh: 当然了，必须带上头盔的。

transcript.en: It's a great ride, but you want to be well prepared because it's very remote -you won't see any shops round there, or anywhere to stay,
transcript.zh: 这是一段很棒的旅程，但是你要做好充分的准备，因为路途遥远，没有任何的商店或者休息的地方，

transcript.en: so you need to get back in time for the last boat.
transcript.zh: 因此你们要赶在最后一趟船之前返回。

transcript.en: Yeah. So what sort of prices are we looking at here?
transcript.zh: 好的。那么价格是多少呢？

transcript.en: Let's see, that'd be one adult and one child for the cruise with farm tour,
transcript.zh: 我看看，一个成年人，一个儿童参加巡航旅游加上农场参观，

transcript.en: that's $117, and an adult and a child for the cruise only so that's $214 dollars altogether.
transcript.zh: 共计117美元，然后一个成年人，一个儿童只参加巡航旅游，一共加起来是214美元。

transcript.en: Oh, wait a minute, how old did you say your daughter was?
transcript.zh: 哦，等一下，你女儿多大了来着？

transcript.en: Fifteen.
Then I'm afraid it's $267 because she has to pay the adult fare,
transcript.zh: 那就是267美元了，因为她必须按照成人票的价格，

transcript.en: which is $75 instead of the child fare which is $22 -sorry about that.
transcript.zh: 也就是75美元，而不是22美元的儿童票了。不好意思。

transcript.en: That's OK.
transcript.zh: 没事儿。

transcript.en: Er. so how do…
